notas_originais: Succ. 34 a חילפא ג' a willow with rounded leaves. Sabb. 110 a; Men. 42 b (מ)גביא ג' (v. מַגַּבְיָא) liquid alum in rounded form (στυπτηρία στρογγύλη, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Stypteria).

Targ. Job XIII, 25.—Ḥull. 46 b a feather, spittle, או ג' or a piece of straw. Ib. 56 b top ג' דחיטתא a piece of wheat straw. Nidd. 26 b דרמינן ליה בג' דחטתא on whom we may throw wheat chaff, i.e. embarrass with petty questions.— Pl. גִּילֵי, גִּילֵּי. Targ. Ex. V, 12. Targ. Job XLI, 20 sq.—Snh. 108 b, v. גִּיר III.—Succ. 14 a בגִילַיְיהוּ (grains) in their haulms.—בֵּי גִּילֵּי dumping ground, marsh. גילדנא דבי ג' the small fish living among the reeds in the swamps. Ber. 44 b; Keth. 105 b

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גלי; cmp. שִׁילְהֵי fr. שלה) [descobertas,] flashes, o horizonte brilhante.
definicoes_originais: (גלי; cmp. שִׁילְהֵי fr. שלה) [ uncoverings,] flashes, the glowing horizon.
notas_originais: Taan. 3 b גי' דליליא (Ms. M. גו') the glow after sunset. Pes. 13 a top בגי' וכ' Ms. M. (ed. בגילויא) he was standing in the glow before sunrise (mistaking it for the flashing of sunrise, v. הָנֵץ); Snh. 42 a (ed. בגילויא).
Macc. 21 a ג' שיש בו וכ' a cutting with which a destruction is connected (which attacks the roots); a. fr.
Targ. Is. XV, 2; Jer. XLVIII, 37, v. גְּלִיבָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גלי); descobrindo.; a lei que proíbe o uso de líquidos deixados descobertos (possivelmente envenenados por serpentes).
definicoes_originais: the law forbidding the use of liquids that were left uncovered (as possibly poisoned by serpents).
notas_originais: —ג' עריות uncovering of nakedness, incest (Lev. XVIII, 6; a. fr.). Yoma 9 a; a. fr.—ג' ראש bareheadedness. Sabb. 118 b.—ג' פנים barefacedness, defiance. Sot. 42 b, v. גָּלְיַת. Erub. 69 a מומר וג' פנים an apostate and a defiant person, expl. מומר בג' פ' a defiant apostate; a. e.

Ter. VIII, 4 אסורים משום ג' are forbidden on account of gilluy ; a. fr.— Pl. גִּילּוּיִים, גִּילּוּיִין. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41 a bot.; Y. Ter. VIII, 45 c bot. [read:] שהיה מלגלג בג' (not מגלגל, not בגילוי יין) who sneered at the law of gilluy

verbetes.glosa_atual: 1) o mesmo.; mesmo. Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 2 גִּילּוּי בשרא nudez.; superfície brilhante e polida.
definicoes_originais: same. Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 2 גִּילּוּי בשרא nakedness.
notas_originais: ch.

Ib. XIII, 13; Num. XXXV, 25 ג' ערייתא = h. גִּילּוּי עריות.—Esp. liquids left uncovered, law concerning them. Ḥull. 49 b כי הוה להו ג' when they had a case of uncovered liquids. Gitt. 69 b לג' וכ' against the danger from drinking uncovered liquids apply &c. Ab. Zar. 30 a אג' לא קפדי they care not for the law concerning uncovered liquids; a. fr.—גִּלּוּי דעתא intimation of meaning. Gitt. 34 a בג' ד' בגיטא וכ' they differ with regard to one intimating the annulment of a letter of divorce.

Zeb. 38 b אַגִּילּוּיֵיה on its (the altar’s) top surface cleared of ashes.—Snh. 42 a; Pes. 13 a, v. גִּילְהֵי.—Targ. Nah. II, 8 בגִילַּיָּא ed. Lag. (oth. ed. בגָלַיָּא) openly (not in a covered carriage), v. גְּלֵי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גמל desmamar, treinar) uma vara pontiaguda amarrada ao pescoço de um bezerro para evitar que ele chupe (v. שִׁירְתּוּעַ), ou uma pequena canga colocada no bezerro para quebrá-lo.
definicoes_originais: (גמל to wean, train) a pointed pole tied to the neck of a calf to prevent it from sucking (v. שִׁירְתּוּעַ), or a little yoke put on the calf for breaking it in.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. V, 7 c top אית תניין תני ג' some teachers read (Mish. V, 4) gimol (in place of gimon) in the sense of גמל in I Sam. I, 24; v. next w.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (גמם acoplar, amarrar) um pequeno jugo (בר נִירָא), ou uma tábua amarrada à cabeça de um bezerro (פִּינַקְסָה), ou uma vara pontiaguda (שִׁירְתּוּעַ, v. precedido. w.).
definicoes_originais: (גמם to couple, tie) a little yoke (בר נִירָא), or a board tied to the head of a calf (פִּינַקְסָה), or a pointed pole (שִׁירְתּוּעַ, v. preced. w.).
notas_originais: Sabb. V, 4; expl. Y. ib. V, 7 c; Bab. ib. 54 b.—Y. l. c. מאן דמר ג' וכ' he who reads gimon supports the opinion of R. Ḥisda (פינקסה); he who reads gimol supports the opinions &c. (שירתוע or בר נירא).— Pl. גִּימֹונֹות, v. next w.
Pl. גִּימֹונִיֹּות. Succ. III, 8 ג' של זהב gold bands; Tosef. ib. II, 10 גִּימֹונֹות.

verbetes.glosa_atual: (uma transposição de γραμματεῖον,… άτια, pl.); contas.; o uso de letras para seu valor numérico; interpretação homilética baseada no valor numérico das letras.; aprendeu a escrever, cifer.
definicoes_originais: the use of letters for their numerical value; homiletic interpretation based on the numerical value of letters.
notas_originais: Y. Ter. V, 43 c bot. חשבון ג' arithmetical calculation.

Ber. 8 a ת̇ו̇צ̇א̇ו̇ת̇ בגי' וכ' the word totsaoth (Ps. LXVIII, 21) intimates 903 (causes of death). Lev. R. s. 21 השטן גי' וכ'; Midr. Till. to Ps. XXVII השט"ן בגי' וכ' hassatan (the accuser) counts 364; a. fr.
Snh. 22 a בגי' איכתיב (Ms. M. איתחזי) the inscription of the wall was in cifers (א"ת ב"ש).— Pl. גִּימַטְרְיָאֹות arithmetic. Ab. III, 18.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Gimmel, terceira letra do Alfabeto; valor numérico, três.
definicoes_originais: Gimmel, third letter of the Alphabet; numerical value, three.
notas_originais: Shek. III, 2; a. fr.—Sabb. 104 a (childrens’ mnemonical play) גי' דל"ת גֹמול דֹלים (Ms. M. גמל) Gimmel-Daleth intimates, Do good to the poor. Ib. כרעיה דג' the foot of the Gimmel; a. fr.— Pl. גִּמְלִין. Ib. 103 b one must not write … ג' צדין וכ' Ms. M. (ed. גַּמִּין) Gimmels so as to be possibly taken for Tsaddes.
